observations: Photo 0: Nikon DSLR body on a table; top shows “Nikon” branding and the model marking “D610” is visible on the top-right area.
Photo 1: Another angle of the same Nikon D610 body; no lens attached in the visible shots.
Photo 2: Rear/side angle showing the camera back and mode dial; LCD screen is visible but not readable for status/menus.

claims.claim: Used Nikon D610 in good condition.
claims.evidence: Photos show a used body with possible cosmetic wear, but no clear evidence of shutter count, sensor condition, or full functionality.

claims.claim: May show sign of cosmetic wears.
claims.evidence: Body appears used with minor scuffs/marks visible on the casing in photos 0 and 1.
No battery or accessories are shown in the provided photos.

risks.risk: Shutter count / heavy usage (affects lifespan and resale value).
risks.proof: A screenshot/photo from the camera showing shutter count (or a camera info screen that includes it) or a shutter count report from a connected app.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a used body with unknown shutter count (worst-case: higher wear).

risks.risk: Sensor condition (dust, fungus, scratches) and image quality.
risks.proof: A test photo of a blank wall at f/8–f/11 plus a close-up crop of the result (or a sensor cleaning check photo).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially needing cleaning/with possible sensor dust (worst-case for image quality).

risks.risk: Full functionality (AF, buttons, dials, ports, hot shoe, LCD brightness, card slot).
risks.proof: Short video showing: power on, menu navigation, autofocus on a subject, taking a photo, and reviewing it on the LCD.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not fully verified (worst-case: assume some functions may be faulty).

risks.risk: Missing accessories / incomplete kit (battery, charger, body cap, cables).
risks.proof: Photos laid out showing every included item (battery model label, charger, body cap, straps, manuals).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as body-only or incomplete kit until accessories are shown.

risks.risk: Lens not included (if seller intends to include one, it’s not shown).
risks.proof: Clear photo(s) of the lens (front element, mount, serial/model) if any lens is included; otherwise confirm “no lens”.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as camera body only (worst-case: no lens).

proof_requests: Photo of the included battery and charger (labels visible) and a full accessories layout.
Shutter count screenshot/report from the camera or a connected app.
Test shot sample (blank wall) at f/8–f/11 with a crop showing dust/fungus.
Short functionality video: power on → menu → autofocus on a subject → take photo → playback.
response.reason: The photos clearly identify a Nikon D610 body, but key value drivers (shutter count, sensor condition, and included accessories) are not verifiable from the images. To price confidently in Oyo, you need proof of shutter count, sensor test, and what exactly comes in the box.
